$Comment: The Horseman's Steed, the black horse a player rides once the Horseman's Reins are theirs: his mounted model's horse with no rider on it. Parent Horse brings the game's living horse: its shape, hitbox, size and every animation, so it walks, runs and carries a rider as any horse does. Texture swaps its coat for his black horse's (NPC/Hallows_Eve/Headless_Horseman/Horse/, painted on the horse's own layout, the same coat his mounted model wears). RandomAttachmentSets is empty so the horse's random mane never goes on (the barding covers the neck, and a second tail would sit inside his own). DefaultAttachments replaces the parent's list whole: the barding (it brings its own saddle) and the rotted tail. Icon is its portrait, drawn by tools/derive_art.py.
